From: Lucas Meyer <lucas@techbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-08T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Technical handshake for pilot environment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team is excited about Redwood and we want to move toward a short pilot. Before we lock dates, can we align on the technical workstream in the MAP: specifically org setup (tenant/owner), API key issuance and rotation cadence, IP allowlist ranges, and the VPC peering window?

Quick context: our infra team prefers to provision peering in the week of July 25-29 and will need a CIDR for routing and a maint window. We can share a network diagram if helpful. For keys, we need to understand whether we can use scoped service keys per-environment and who signs the request.

Could you share a simple MAP draft with owners and dates so we can confirm with procurement and security? Also, do you have a checklist for evidence requests (SOC 2, audit logs) we should expect?

Best,
Lucas
Sr. Platform Engineer
TechBridge Inc.

Hi Lucas — great to hear the team's aligned.

I put together a short MAP draft (attached) covering the technical workstream and proposed close timeline for the pilot environment. High level:
- Org & tenant: we recommend TechBridge create an evaluation org; Redwood will provision a tenant and invite two admin users. Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Lucas (TechBridge) — target July 18.
- API keys: we can issue scoped service keys per-environment. Initial keys for staging+pilot issued on July 19; rotation cadence suggested every 90 days. Owner: Ben Carter.
- IP allowlist: please confirm the CIDR blocks you plan to originate; we will add to allowlist once confirmed. Target: allowlist in place by July 26.
- VPC peering: proposed maintenance window July 25–27 with a fallback week Aug 1–3. Owner: Jordan Blake.

Attachments: MAP_Technical_Workstream_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with milestone rows and owners).
Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleMAPDriveLink

Security artifacts: we have a short SOC 2 evidence pack and an audit-logs export plan. I included the items you asked for in the MAP under the compliance column.

Next steps: can you confirm the CIDR(s) and a preferred peering window? If that looks good I'll lock the dates and send calendar invites for a 30-minute network sync.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
